items.content_html: MemoMint is a lightweight, user-friendly decentralized application (dApp) built on the Solana blockchain, allowing users to send short messages—called memos—that are permanently recorded on-chain. It is built using the Codigo Memo Template, part of the Solana AI-assisted development suite, and developed as a submission for the Codigo x Superteam.
